title: Mark Zuckerberg: First Interview in the Metaverse | Lex Fridman Podcast #398
summary: Lex Fridman interviews Mark Zuckerberg in the metaverse, with both appearing as photorealistic avatars from separate locations. They discuss Meta's AI, VR and the future of avatars.
why: HN points to it as a demonstration that VR presence can feel close to talking in person.

quote.text: The Fridman - Zuckerberg VR interview really convinced me of this, if you haven't seen it, check it out, it's incredible
